comment: Exact pins, not ranges, so the image builds the same way twice; bump them deliberately with the battery green. No zod: a tool's schema is declared as plain JSON Schema, because a zod conversion emits a `$schema` URL the gateway's outbound walk refuses (see the reference server, backend/agents/_examples/vercel_ai_answer_ts/server.ts). The devDependencies are the type checker only — the image installs with --omit=dev and tsx strips types without checking them, so `npm run typecheck` is what reads them.
